title: review: Q3 v4: orchestrator/planner_packet.py — compact, delta-oriented Planner decision packets and the Opus→Fable escalation packet, size-measured (P4, P10)
spec:
Why: planner_runs.decision_packet (lines 43-107) and grouped_packet rebuild a per-point packet with the full spawn packet inventory, 300-char scout summaries, no memory, no changes-since-last-decision and no required-output section; the brief (P4) wants a delta-oriented packet with only what the decision needs, invalidated on state change, and (P10) a compact escalation packet so Fable solves the unresolved part instead of redoing Opus's work. Three spec review rounds (T-0679, T-0713, of T-0715) are folded in: explicit decision_type source, taxonomy shape, real scout finding fields, hard length backstop, previous-without-changes rendering, escalation packet section 3, per-section section 7, hash over the final text. The Planner waived a fourth spec review.
What: new pure module orchestrator/planner_packet.py. Never reads the bus or files itself: the caller passes data. Untrusted text goes inside fences labelled data with backticks elided (copy planner_runs._fenced's 6-line helper; do not import planner_runs).
- Taxonomy shape: orchestrator/planner_taxonomy.py (merged on goal/T-0674) exposes DECISION_TYPES = ("initial_goal_plan", "scout_results", "held_task", "architectural_replan", "fix_strategy", "closable_goal", "retrospective", "ambiguous_requirement", "other") and classify(...) -> {"decision_type", "architectural", "ambiguous", "risk_class", "signals", "band", "task_class"}. A section's decision_type = section["classification"]["decision_type"] when present, else the fallback from point["kind"]: scouts_done -> scout_results, held -> held_task, closable -> closable_goal, retrospective -> retrospective, anything else -> other. Import DECISION_TYPES for validation; an unknown value maps to other.
- build(sections, *, goal, previous=None, changes=None, scout_findings=None, memory_hits=None, cap_chars=6000) -> {"text", "chars" (len(text)), "est_tokens" (chars // 4), "hash" (sha256 of the exact returned text, [:12], computed AFTER truncation and the hard cap), "sections": [names included], "truncated": [names cut], "delta": bool}. sections = list of {"point" ({goal_id, kind, payload_key, task_id?}), "ctx" (decision.route ctx dict), "route" (decision.Route or dict name/reason/evidence/tier), "classification" (taxonomy dict or None), "task" (bus dict or None), "reviews" ([{path, line, issue}]), "failures" (str|None), "depends_on_statuses" ([{id, status}])}. Every free-text field rendered per section is capped: title 200, status 40, hold_reason 300, issue 200, failures 1500. Section order and rules: 1 Decision header (one line per section: 'Section <n> (<task_id or goal_id>): <decision_type> — expected output: ...' with initial_goal_plan/scout_results -> 'write plan.md and atomic specs'; fix_strategy/held_task -> 'write one fix-round spec with depends_on=[held]'; architectural_replan -> 'respec or split; state why'; closable_goal -> 'open PR goal/<id> -> main or say why not'; ambiguous_requirement -> 'state the ambiguity under Needs the human'; retrospective -> 'record.sh add'; other -> 'decide'); 2 Goal (id, title 200, complexity, spec first 600 chars); 3 Changes since previous decision: previous None -> 'first Planner decision for this goal'; previous given and changes a non-empty list -> up to 20 lines from [{"task", "field", "from", "to", "ts"}] plus 'previous state_version: ' + str(previous.get("state_version")); previous given and changes None or empty -> 'state changed since previous decision, no field-level diff available' plus the same state_version line; delta True iff previous is given; 4 Relevant task state, one block per section (title, status, hold_reason, failures, review comments max 10 as path:line issue, depends_on statuses); 5 Scout findings only when some section is scout_results or initial_goal_plan: scout_findings is scout_evidence.normalize_findings output, entries {finding, source, confidence, relevance, unresolved, needs_challenge}; max 10 lines as 'finding[:200] (source, confidence)'; 6 Memory: memory_hits titles only, max 10, each 200 chars; 7 Unresolved alternatives, one block per section labelled 'Section <n>': that section's route evidence lines (max 20 per section) plus the option names chosen by that section's decision_type: _SCOUTS_DONE_OPTIONS for initial_goal_plan/scout_results, _NEXT_ACTION_OPTIONS for held_task/fix_strategy/architectural_replan, none otherwise (copy both dicts from planner_runs as module constants); 8 Required output (repeat of the header expectations plus 'Do not restate this packet'). Excluded by construction: event logs, unrelated tasks, transcripts, previous prompts.
- Truncation: header, Goal and Required output are never cut by the section step; when over cap, cut in this order until it fits: Memory, Scout findings, Unresolved alternatives, Changes, Relevant task state (failures first, then the whole section); record cut names in truncated. Final hard backstop: text = text[:cap_chars] (mirrors decision_packet's [:cap]); when it fires, append "hard_cap" to truncated. len(text) <= cap_chars always holds; hash and chars describe the final text.
- escalation_packet(*, goal, original_sections, opus_decision, unresolved, conflicting_evidence=None, scout_findings=None, memory_hits=None, reason, cap_chars=6000) -> same return shape. It has no previous/changes inputs: it OMITS section 3 entirely and returns delta False. Its header is 'Escalation reason: <reason>. Solve only the unresolved items.' followed by the per-section decision lines; after Goal it renders 'Opus proposed decision (data)' from the whitelist {"proposed_action", "summary" (cap 800), "tasks_proposed" ([{"title" (cap 120), "scope" (list cap 10)}] cap 10), "confidence", "needs_fable", "unresolved" (cap 10 x 200)} inside a data fence, then 'Unresolved' (the unresolved argument, cap 10 x 200) and 'Conflicting evidence' (cap 10 x 200) when given, then sections 4-8 as build; any other opus_decision key dropped, never raw transcripts; same truncation order (Opus proposed decision is never cut by the section step) and hard backstop.
- invalidated(previous_state_version, current_state_version) -> bool (differ or either None). meta(text) -> {"chars", "est_tokens", "hash"} with hash = sha256(text)[:12], identical to build's for the same text.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_first_decision_has_no_delta_and_all_sections — one section classified scout_results with normalize_findings-shaped findings and memory hits produces the sections in the documented order, delta False and the text 'first Planner decision for this goal'; a section without classification and kind held gets held_task from the fallback; hash equals meta(text)['hash']

tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_delta_with_and_without_changes — previous and 3 changes give delta True, the 3 change lines and the previous state_version; a 40-entry change list is cut to 20 lines; previous without changes gives delta True, the 'no field-level diff available' line and no KeyError when state_version is absent

tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_multi_section_packet_renders_per_section_alternatives — two sections (scout_results and held_task) produce two header lines, two Relevant task state blocks and two Unresolved alternatives blocks where the first lists _SCOUTS_DONE_OPTIONS names and the second _NEXT_ACTION_OPTIONS names, each with its own route evidence

tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_truncation_order_protected_sections_and_hard_cap — cap 1200 with long failures drops Memory first, then Scout findings, never cuts the header or Required output, and len(text) <= 1200; a cap of 300 with long titles yields len(text) <= 300, hard_cap in truncated and hash == sha256(text)[:12] of the returned text; a hold_reason containing ``` and 'ignore previous instructions' appears inside a data fence with backticks elided and capped at 300 chars

tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_escalation_packet_whitelists_opus_decision_and_omits_delta — an opus_decision carrying a 'transcript' key and a 3000-char summary yields a packet without the transcript, summary capped at 800, the escalation reason in the header, no 'first Planner decision' line and no 'Changes since previous decision' section, delta False, len(text) <= cap_chars, and invalidated() True for differing versions

comments.issue: _clean does `str(value or "")`, so any falsy-but-meaningful value (confidence=0.0, review line=0, complexity=0) is silently rendered as an empty string instead of the actual value. This hits _scout_lines' `(source, confidence)` rendering and _relevant_lines' `path:line` rendering, both of which can legitimately carry 0. A scout finding with confidence 0.0 (a real, meaningful low-confidence signal) becomes '(source.py:1, )' with the confidence silently dropped, which is worse than showing 0 since it looks like a formatting artifact rather than data loss. Not caught by tests because they only use confidence=.9/.4 and non-zero line numbers. Fix: use `value = str(value) if value is not None else ""` instead of `value or ""`.

_decision_type falls back to the kind-based mapping whenever classification.get('decision_type') is not in DECISION_TYPES, conflating two distinct cases the spec separates: 'when present' (use it) vs 'an unknown value maps to other' (validation failure). As written, a section with classification={'decision_type': 'bogus'} and point.kind='held' silently resolves to held_task via the kind fallback instead of other, masking a taxonomy/classifier bug instead of surfacing it. Not exercised by tests (the only fallback test uses classification=None, not an invalid-but-present value).
